ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Calculator Usage
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious use of 'calc.exe' with command line parameters or in a suspicious directory, which is likely caused by some PoC or detection evasion.

sequences.query: process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\calc\\\.exe\\ .*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\.*"))))
